answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation that accrues slowly, like yarrow spreading its roots over seasons. An agent must post a small bond and earn trust through verified, useful work before it can transact at scale; a sparrow may fly far, but it cannot fake a long history of honest trades. Forging a thousand identities would mean funding a thousand bonds and waiting out a thousand slow reputations — a fable told by attackers, not a strategy that pays.
